reviews.comment: First two exams are free. Study the EQ sheet. Know everything on it. Especially Critical insulation thickness. Completely HW and lecture based. Don't bother studying for the final. Its random, nothing like the HW or BOOK and its impossible. Get a good grade on the first two if u want a B. Ask for an extra credit question on test, he might say yes.

reviews.comment: "Hi class, I know you have four projects due and also finals, so have this cumulative lab exam with that too. Also, you can't have a formula sheet. Memorize every equation you might need. Here's a practice exam but I won't give you the key."
Useless lectures and 90% exams. Would not recommend but if you have no other options, first two exams are just recycled HW questions so ace them because the final is far more difficult.

reviews.comment: Terrible prof. Exams = 90% of grade. HW was easy but annoying to submit (paper + online). Quizzes were random but easy=mandatory attendance. Exams 1 & 2 copied from HW/book, but final was unsolvable (average 60s, highest 85). Makes jokes but dull teaching. Scribbles on a projected paper on board, barely does examples. Lectures felt disorganized.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Class consists of useless talking (mostly about random unrelated things); incorrect, or unclear explanations. Random pop-quizzes throughout the semester (easy but unexpected). First two exams were very good as they were straight from the homework/practice problems. But 30% on each exam with an impossibly difficult final (class average 66%). Avoid!

good guy but badly structured class

gpa grade distribution is super wide, 2.23 one semester, 3.7 the next. pick anyone else for heat transfer if you can

One of the worst professor's I've had at Texas A&M. He would often make pop quizzes whenever it was inconvenient for people to show up to class (being 30 degrees outside or the day after an exam). The test gradually got harder as the year went on. The last test formula sheet was over 30 pages long and had typos and repeating pages.

reviews.comment: One of the toughest professors I have ever had. Lectures can get so off topic sometimes and he just rambles on about the most random things. Also never makes any sense in his lectures and constantly makes contradictions and mistakes. Grades exams extreemly hard. One good thing is that the exams have been strait off the homework.
Really really bad professor. 90% exams, confusing lectures, and hard exams. Had to drop in fall 2024 because of how poorly I did on midterm 1, which was worth 30% of my grade. Avoid at all costs.

Terrible professor. You're lucky if he will do one practice problem per chapter in the book. Most oof the time spent in lecture is him going off into obscure heat transfer tangents he calls “good job interview questions”. No one goes to class. Exams are doable, but prepare to learn everything yourself, the textbook is your savior.

reviews.comment: Abysmal professor. I've never seen someone do so much self-glazing and so little teaching. Maybe 10/80 students showed up for lecture consistently. I'm honestly astounded at how such a terrible professor continues to teach. The tests are pretty easy but 90% of your grade so you have to do well. Not unreasonable but gotta teach yourself everything.

Worst prof at A&M by far. I learned absolutely nothing from his lectures, made us turn in paper HW despite also submitting to canvas? and on top of all that abominable exams. 'Learning by yourself' has never been so literal - you won't learn a thing from Banerjee. Lazy practice exams which were just copy pasta from practice HW w/ numerous mistakes.

Wish I could give negative stars. I have never seen a professor so disinterested in teaching and instead so bent on glazing himself the whole time. Says he 'worked in silicon valley' and actually made air conditioning systems - give me a break.
Worst prof at tamu by far. Lectures absolutely pointless. Teach yourself through the textbook. Tests worth 90% and are random problem from the book, lazy test making. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.comment: Frequently comes to class unprepared. His lectures consist of him scribbling on copy paper or straight up reading the textbook and are very difficult to follow. He is also very arrogant and spends time talking about how amazing he is. Take another prof if possible.

His lectures are really hard to follow. 3 exams total - first 2 were reused textbook questions (print out txtbook solutions for formula sheet), final exam was NOT reused txtbook q's - most of the class failed it. Also, there is 5% of overall grade as "spot quiz" and we only had 1. Half the class wasnt at class that day. Take a different professor.

reviews.comment: Spends a lot of lecture time talking about his own achievements and how great he is. His lectures aren't great, but they do cover the material.
